To guide you through the preparation of a classic Beef Wellington, here is your customized prompt:

"Act as an expert culinary instructor. Guide me step-by-step through the preparation of a Beef Wellington. Start with selecting the right cut of beef tenderloin, then detail the process of searing, applying the duxelles (mushroom mixture), wrapping in prosciutto and puff pastry, and finally, baking to the correct internal temperature. Include tips for ensuring the pastry remains crisp and the beef stays medium-rare."
